title: Duolingo: lesson input and completion
role_for_mira: Supplementary reference for visible input alternatives and differentiated controls.

provenance.kind: related exercise states; not one continuous recording

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Instruction at top; response/input in the center; action and alternative input route toward the bottom.
The last image is a path/collection screen, not a completion receipt.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Medium; the path image is denser than the exercise templates.

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: Related stills show different exercise templates; their order does not establish a continuous user journey.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: Audio and microphone controls are visible, but no waveform timing, audio routing, haptic intensity, or interaction latency is measured.

hierarchy.value: Input-specific instructions make listening and speaking different tasks. Alternatives are visible rather than relying on a hidden gesture.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Keep text accessible from voice and make recording vs playback/reply distinct. Do not copy lesson scores, gating, or the misidentified completion image.
